queries.entities_with_list_name: MATCH (n:__Entity__) WHERE NOT n.name IS :: STRING RETURN count(n) AS n
queries.duplicate_name_groups_case_or_space: MATCH (n:__Entity__) WHERE n.name IS :: STRING WITH toLower(trim(n.name)) AS key, count(*) AS c WHERE c > 1 RETURN count(key) AS n
queries.chunks_with_no_entity: MATCH (c:Chunk) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (:__Entity__)-[:FROM_CHUNK]->(c) } RETURN count(c) AS n
queries.distinct_publisher_names: MATCH (p:Publisher) RETURN count(DISTINCT toLower(trim(toString(p.name)))) AS n
queries.entities_in_duplicate_groups: MATCH (n:__Entity__) WHERE n.name IS :: STRING WITH toLower(trim(n.name)) AS key, count(*) AS c WHERE c > 1 RETURN sum(c) AS n
